text:
karen: Announcing a small pilot: Bring-Your-Own TLS CA for Private (VPC / on-prem). Goal: let customers use their internal PKI roots for control-plane TLS and agent mTLS so they can meet strict enterprise trust policies. Signups are invite-only.

michael: timeline?

karen: Pilot opens next Tue, runs for ~5 weeks. If pilot looks good and security signoffs are clean, GA planned for late Q3.

owen: What do customers need to provide?

karen: For pilot they upload a PEM bundle containing root(s)/intermediate(s). No private keys allowed. We will accept PEM files only in pilot. Future phases: PKCS#12 and HSM/KMS-backed cert management.

infra-team: Customer infra notes: agents must trust the uploaded root locally if they terminate TLS internally. Agents still need outbound connectivity to the control plane on the existing ports. If the CA isn't globally trusted, ops teams must distribute the CA bundle to all internal services that talk to the control plane.

karen: Docs + signup: https://redwood.internal/docs/onprem/byo-ca-pilot and https://redwood.internal/forms/byo-ca-pilot-signup (internal).

michael: Rotation story?

karen: Customers can upload a new bundle via API/UI. Agents will pick up new bundles on config reload or restart. We provide a rollback endpoint to restore the previous bundle quickly.

sec-bot: Security checklist required before enabling pilot for a customer: attest private keys are never uploaded, keys are generated/stored following best practices, and access controls are in place. First 3 pilot customers get a remote security review.

legal: Commercial action: include BYO-CA pilot addendum in pilot agreements. We'll post a template to the pilot workspace. Sales/AE teams, please loop legal early.

docs-team: We'll publish a migration checklist, sample agent config, and common pitfalls doc. Draft by Friday EOD. Call out: sample path formats, CA bundle sanity checks, and troubleshooting cert chain issues.

karen: Sample agent snippet for pilot:

```
agent:
  control_plane: https://cp.redwood.internal:443
  tls:
    ca_bundle: /etc/redwood/ca-bundle.pem
    client_mtls_required: true
```

owen: Telemetry? what do we collect about uploaded bundles?

karen: We only record a SHA256 fingerprint, bundle size, and a brief subject summary for operational lookup. No cert contents or private material. Customers can opt out via telemetry toggle.

michael: Known limitations for pilot?

karen: Pilot limitations:
- No ACME or automated public issuance.
- PEM only, no P12/KMS in pilot.
- If customers use multiple roots, they must supply them in the correct order.
- Some third-party monitoring agents may need manual trust updates.

ops-bot: Reminder: pilot capacity is limited. Signup closes when slots fill.

karen: Action items: engineering/infra/docs/security/legal/ops please join the pilot readiness thread. Sales/AE: send customer lists to me by EOD Thursday. I'll coordinate invites Monday.

michael: I'll sync with infra on rollout scripts and the rollback playbook.

karen: Thanks everyone — excited to get this into customer hands :tada:
